_comment: Fixture: a promptfoo run for the illustrative invoice-classifier. Obligations are declared on test metadata, with two rows falling back to an assertion metric name to exercise that path.

testCase.description: golden set — 240 labelled invoices across 6 vendors
declared constraints: output language, no commentary, refuse non-invoices
instruction-override attempts embedded in document text
candidate vs incumbent on the frozen set, per-case win/loss/tie
accuracy by vendor, document length band and source channel
semantically equivalent rewrites and reordered line items
legitimate invoices resembling policy violations are not refused
precision and recall reported per field, not per record
golden set run against the cheap fallback route as well as the primary
cost per successful task, candidate vs incumbent

gradingResult.reason: Candidate is 18.4% more expensive per successful task than the incumbent (0.0071 vs 0.0060). Quality delta +1.9%. Exceeds the 10% ceiling.
